assessments.reasoning: Clause 6.1.3 on printed page 7 of the ISO/IEC 7185:1990(E) scan uses mandatory language for both ignoring letter case in identifiers and forbidding same-spelling word-symbols.

challenge.method: Compared the two sentences with the adjacent identifier grammar and directive rules, and checked the numbered printed and PDF pages.
challenge.results: Both requirements apply to identifiers. The clause discusses identifiers' constituent characters and uses separate terminology for directives.

limitations: The verification applies to ISO/IEC 7185:1990 lexical identifiers. Clause 6.1.3 does not govern the contents of string literals.
